messages:
Aarav (PM): Quick sync — need to lock acceptance criteria for Route Resolution & Model Compatibility matrix before PRD handoff. Proposed agenda: must-haves for GA, edge cases, rollout phasing, metrics/SLOs. Can we decide today?
Maya (Eng-Platform): I can make time. My big ask: acceptance criteria must include deterministic fallback behavior documented with examples.
Leo (ML Eng): +1. Also need to specify what 'compatible variant' means (quantized vs fp16 vs model family). We should list compat rules per architecture.
Priya (SRE): From infra: include fail-open vs fail-closed modes per customer tier. Production incidents show ambiguous fallbacks cause flapping.
Nikhil (Eng Runtime): Implementation note: runtime will support prioritized routes + compatibility check hook. We need an API for a compatibility predicate: `is_compatible(request, candidate)` and a pluggable override.
Josh (ProdOps): Customer asks: guarantee no silent quality regressions. Acceptance criteria should require a sampled prompt regression check when a fallback to lower-cost variant occurs.
Aarav (PM): Draft acceptance criteria proposal (short):
- Must: Route decision deterministic for same inputs within 24h window.
- Must: Compatibility matrix published (model family x region x variant) for GA.
- Must: Fallback policy explicit per tier (hosted/dedicated/private), default = "closest compatible variant".
- Must: Regression sentinel: 0.5% sampled requests that go through fallback get logged and flagged if quality delta > threshold.
- Should: Canary rollout with percentage-based traffic shifting and auto-rollback on error rate + quality regressions.
Maya (Eng-Platform): Slight tweak: make determinism timeframe configurable per customer (default 24h) and require idempotent routing for same request_id.
Leo (ML Eng): For "quality delta" we need a concrete metric: use model-agnostic embedding similarity on a curated prompt set + threshold, and a fallback of human review for high-importance customers.
Priya (SRE): Add SLOs: route-decision latency <= 10ms p95, fallback switch latency <= 50ms p95, and no increased request latency beyond 100ms p95 when falling back.
Nikhil (Eng Runtime): Edge case: partial compatibility where only prefix cache is compatible (KV cache mismatch). Proposal: allow prefix-only routing if explicit flag in customer config; otherwise disallow.
Josh (ProdOps): Another edge: cross-region data residency. Acceptance criteria must include an explicit denial for routing to regions not allowed by customer's region policy.
Leo (ML Eng): Compatibility rule examples to include in spec:
```
- same model family, same quantization -> compatible
- same family, different quantization -> compatible if quality delta < 0.03 similarity
- different family -> incompatible unless opt-in migration rule
```
Maya (Eng-Platform): For GA scope negotiation: recommend we ship with: 1) deterministic routing, 2) simple compatibility matrix for curated set of model variants, 3) fallback to pre-approved variants per region, and 4) observability dashboards. Defer prefix-only routing toggle to v1.1.
Aarav (PM): Launch criteria checklist (proposal):
- Compatibility matrix doc published and validated with 3 internal customers.
- Automated regression checks for fallback in CI.
- Dashboard: per-route token cost, p95 latency, fallback rate.
- Runbook for emergency rollback and manual override.
Priya (SRE): Add test: simulate region outage and ensure routing falls back to alternative region only when customer allows cross-region failover. We should have a boolean `allow_cross_region_failover`.
Nikhil (Eng Runtime): API sketch for PRD: `route(request) -> {route_id, model_variant, compatibility_reasons, fallback_chain}`. Include `compatibility_reasons` as structured text for audit.
Josh (ProdOps): Customers want an opt-out for automated rollouts. Add acceptance criteria: enable/disable auto-fallback per customer via console + API.
Aarav (PM): Action items:
- Maya: incorporate determinism/ID requirements into PRD (today).
- Leo: define embedding-similarity test + threshold and add to CI (tomorrow).
- Nikhil: draft runtime API + compat predicate spec (by EOD).
- Priya: add SRE tests and runbook skeleton (by EOD).
- Josh: gather 3 internal customers to validate the compatibility matrix (this week).
Maya (Eng-Platform): I'll start PRD PR and tag reviewers. Will include examples and a couple of short test vectors.
deploy-bot: deployment note: `canary-routing-v1` deployed to staging at 1854007000.
Aarav (PM): Great — let's reconvene after PRD update. If we get alignment today we can mark GA scope and start work next sprint. :thumbsup:
